Q2 is counting Y.B from the same table. Wait, COUNT(Y.B) counts the number of non-null values in column B. If there are any rows where B is null, then COUNT(B) would be less than COUNT(*). Because COUNT(*) counts all rows, while COUNT(B) ignores rows where B is null.

So the difference comes when there are nulls in column B. If I have a row where B is null, then Q1 would count that row, but Q2 would not count that row's B value. Therefore, the two queries would return different results.
